mode.description: Operational mode; use 'production' for stable deployment, 'development' for debugging.

log_level.description: Verbosity of logging output. Choose from 'debug', 'info', 'warn', 'error'.

log_dir.description: Directory where application logs are written.

state_dir.description: Directory for persistent runtime state (e.g., counters, caches).

host.description: Network interface to bind the HTTP server to (e.g., '127.0.0.1' for localhost only).

port.description: TCP port for incoming HTTP connections.

workers.description: Number of worker processes. Set to 0 to auto-scale based on CPU cores.

max_requests_per_worker.description: Maximum requests handled per worker before restart (prevents memory leaks).

upstream_timeout.description: Seconds to wait for a response from an upstream service before timing out.

tls_enabled.description: Enable TLS encryption for incoming connections. Requires valid certificate and key.

tls_cert.description: File path to the TLS certificate (PEM format). Ignored if tls_enabled is false.

tls_key.description: File path to the TLS private key (PEM format). Ignored if tls_enabled is false.

hostname.description: DNS name or IP address of the upstream service.

port.description: Port number of the upstream service.

enabled.description: Whether to include this upstream in the routing pool.

health_check_path.description: Path to probe for upstream health status.

upstreams.description: List of backend services to proxy requests to. At least one upstream must be enabled.

cache_enabled.description: Enable in-memory caching of responses (useful for read-heavy workloads).

cache_max_entries.description: Maximum number of entries the cache can hold when enabled.

cache_ttl.description: Time-to-live for cached entries in seconds (how long to reuse cached responses).
